highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.2 clears eligible Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.

bullets.detail: Drops uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush so subsequent draws cannot reuse those evicted entries. Entries retained elsewhere are not removed.
